name: Yo-Yo-Oh!
source:
Yo-yo enthusiast Yoyo Furuya has just enrolled at Yoyoichien Academy — the elite training ground for tomorrow’s yo-yo champions.

There, he teams up with Rin, a spirited and carefree classmate, and Shion, an aloof upperclassman from a prestigious lineage of yo-yo masters.

As the school’s top talents, the trio is chosen to represent Yoyoichien at the Crawfish Tournament — a high-stakes showdown where the nation’s fiercest high school yo-yo players battle for glory… and the ultimate prize: the mythical Century Yo-Yo.

But whispers swirl of “Awakened” players — rare individuals who can channel superhuman power through their yo-yos... 

[From [url=https://avenueq.itch.io/yo-yo-oh]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
溜溜球爱好者Yoyo Furuya刚刚入读溜溜球园 - 明天溜溜球冠军的精英训练场。

在那里，他与充满活力、无忧无虑的同学凛和来自著名溜溜球大师世系的冷漠高年级生紫苑合作。

作为学校的顶尖人才，这三人被选中代表Yoyoichien参加小龙虾锦标赛，这是一场高风险的对决，全国最凶猛的高中溜溜球运动员将争夺荣耀……以及终极奖品：神话般的世纪溜溜球。

但“觉醒”玩家们却纷纷窃窃私语——他们是罕见的能够通过溜溜球传递超人力量的人…… 

[来自[url=https://avenueq.itch.io/yo-yo-oh]itch.io[/url]]
